# Code.org Studio

> Code.org Studio is a free platform for K-12 computer science education featuring interactive coding tutorials, AI learning experiences, and block-based programming with popular franchises like Minecraft and Disney.

Studio.code.org serves as the primary interactive learning platform for Code.org's curriculum, offering beginner-friendly lessons in computer science, artificial intelligence, and coding fundamentals. The platform integrates with major authentication providers and features engaging content partnerships with popular media brands.

## Key Topics

- Block-based coding
- AI fundamentals
- Minecraft activities
- Hour of Code
- K-12 curriculum
- Computer science education
- Interactive lessons
- Beginner-friendly
- OAuth authentication
- Code.org
- Minecraft
- Disney partnerships
- Account creation
- Login systems
- Educational technology

## Authentication & Account Management

- [Sign In](https://studio.code.org/users/sign_in): Sign in page with OAuth support via Google, Microsoft, Facebook, Clever, and ClassLink

## AI & Computer Science Curriculum

- [Hour of AI: Learn AI & CS with Minecraft](https://studio.code.org/api/hour/begin/mc): Hour of AI with Minecraft: free interactive lessons teaching AI and CS fundamentals through block-based coding
